question: Top 10 cidades com mais mortes de idosos (> 60 anos)
sql: SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(mo."N_AIH") AS total_mortes FROM mortes mo JOIN internacoes i ON mo."N_AIH" = i."N_AIH" JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."IDADE" > 60 AND mo."CID_MORTE" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY total_mortes DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Cidade com mais mortes de homens
sql: SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(mo."N_AIH") AS total_mortes FROM mortes mo JOIN internacoes i ON mo."N_AIH" = i."N_AIH" JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."SEXO" = 1 GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY total_mortes DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Contar mortes de pessoas com menos de 30 anos
sql: SELECT COUNT(mo."N_AIH") FROM mortes mo JOIN internacoes i ON mo."N_AIH" = i."N_AIH" WHERE i."IDADE" < 30;

question: Quantas mortes cardiovasculares?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mortes WHERE "CID_MORTE" LIKE 'I%';

question: Top 3 diagnósticos mais comuns
sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid10 c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Quantos casos obstétricos tiveram acompanhamento pré-natal?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obstetricos WHERE "INSC_PN" IS NOT NULL AND "INSC_PN" != '';

question: Cidade com mais mortes masculinas
sql: SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(m."N_AIH") AS total FROM mortes m JOIN internacoes i ON m."N_AIH" = i."N_AIH" JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."SEXO" = 1 GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Qual a taxa de mortalidade para faixa etária 30-45?
sql: SELECT '30-45 anos' AS faixa_etaria, COUNT(DISTINCT i."N_AIH") AS total_internacoes, COUNT(DISTINCT m."N_AIH") AS total_mortes, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT m."N_AIH")::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT i."N_AIH") * 100, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN mortes m ON i."N_AIH" = m."N_AIH" WHERE i."IDADE" BETWEEN 30 AND 45;
